verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list support for FP8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, and other quantization formats as first-class features. An older community comment (2023) mentions lack of 4-bit support, but this predates the current documented support and doesn't concretely contradict current capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of loading these quantized formats successfully, and more recent community validation beyond docs.
